title: Lokesh lays foundation for ₹6.30-crore works at Mangalagiri Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy temple
description: The works include a new Yagasala and the renovation of the Vahanasala, Ghanta Mandapam and Sri Krishna Devaraya Mandapam; the Minister asked officials to draw up a master plan for the Mangalagiri temple
